text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship returns from her quest for Eden just in time to make her debut race. But right before the race starts, what should she see but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A chihuahua through a stick of chikuwa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I send Gold Ship off to the race with an anxious prayer, wondering if she'll be able to tap into her full potential.
